slides.title: How much time does it take?
slides.body: One short video, then 15–20 minutes of making together. Most families finish a lesson in one sitting.

slides.title: Does my kid need their own AI accounts?
slides.body: No. Every tool runs on your account, so you're in the room for all of it and see everything they make.

slides.title: Do we need to code?
slides.body: No. There's no coding anywhere in the course. Kids 6–14 can do every lesson with a grown-up.

slides.title: What's the difference between the plans?
slides.body: Both have all 37 lessons. On Creator + Homework, Anna personally reviews every piece your kid sends in, the same day.

slides.title: What if it's not for us?
slides.body: Finish the first lessons. Not right for your family? One email within 30 days and you get a full refund.
